curation_note: Curated by hand (with Claude's help) from the timetable's legend (PDF page 6) and rules pages (115-117). The course table itself is in code processed/timetable.json.

periods.description: Period number -> clock time. Each period is 50 minutes.

days.description: Day codes used in the DAYS column.

source.quote: M = Monday T = Tuesday W = Wednesday Th = Thursday F = Friday S = Saturday

midsem_sessions.description: Midsem exam session codes -> clock times.

compre_sessions.description: Comprehensive exam session codes -> clock times. Lab courses' compre dates are announced by the instructor-in-charge.

source.quote: FN: 9.00 A.M. to 12.00 P.M. AN: 2.00 P.M. to 5.00 P.M. Comprehensive examination date for lab courses to be announced by Instructor-in-charge

credit_columns.description: Meaning of the credit columns. T, S and CH belong to the credit-hour framework (2026+ admissions).

values.CH: total credit hours of the course (credit-hour framework)

source.quote: L = Lecture hours per week P = Practical hours per week T = Tutorial hours per week* S = Self-study hours per week* U = Total units of the course; CH = Total credit hours of the course* ... * Credit Hour framework, part of new curriculum, is approved by the Senate. This applies to all courses introduced for the students admitted in 2026 onwards

com_code_rule.description: Courses with COM COD >= 5000 are only for 2026 admissions into FD, HD and PhD.

source.quote: Courses with com cod >=5000 are meant only for 2026 admissions into FD, HD and PHD and not for others

com_code_rule.note: Already applied in code processed/timetable.json as allowed_for_before_2026_batch.

rules.description: A lunch hour must be free every day, in period 4, 5 or 6.

source.quote: that they have provision for lunch hour on all days (lunch hours are 4, 5 and 6).

rules.description: Comprehensive exam dates must not clash.

source.quote: Comprehensive Examination Dates are not clashing.

rules.note: A clash = same compre_date and compre_session in code processed/timetable.json.

rules.description: Students must include common hours / tutorial hours and all test dates in their timetable.

source.quote: to include the common hour/tutorial hours of courses in their Timetable. To include test date, day & hour of all courses in their Timetable/Examination Schedule blank.

rules.note: Midsem clashes (same date and session) are checked the same way as compre clashes.

rules.description: First degree students may register at most 4 electives more than the programme requires; more needs AUGS permission, otherwise the course gets 'RC'.

source.quote: First degree students are allowed to register a maximum of four more electives than what is required in the programme. ... If students register for an extra elective without permission, their registration in it will be cancelled unilaterally and they will be awarded 'RC' in the course.

rules.description: Registering in a course the student isn't eligible for gets it cancelled with 'RC'.

source.quote: If students register in any course for which they are not eligible, their registration in it will be cancelled unilaterally and they will be awarded 'RC' in such a course unless a request for substitution is made within the prescribed time, and substitution is permitted.

rules.description: Integrated first degree students taking a higher degree course as an elective must have cleared or be registered in the CDC of that course's discipline; at most one per semester.

values.requires: cleared or registered in the CDC of the respective discipline

source.quote: Students must have cleared or registered in the CDC of respective discipline of the higher degree course. Only one higher degree course can be taken as elective in a semester.

rules.description: Another programme's CDC taken as an elective needs the named prior-preparation courses of that CDC (group A & B programmes).

values.requires: all named prior preparation courses of that discipline's CDC

source.section: V. Suggestions for choosing electives, Registration of CDC as Elective
source.quote: CDC which is not a part of the compulsory requirements of the student (single degree or dual degree): For a CDC of group A & B programmers, students must have cleared all the named prior preparation courses of that discipline's CDC.

rules.note: Which programmes are in groups A, B and C isn't defined in these documents.

source.quote: Please see the details available at https://academic.bits-pilani..ac.in/
